placements.why: The document defines organizational policies and operational intake rules governing data retention limits, liability mitigation, and automated lifecycle compliance.
placements.title: Governance, Retention Boundaries, and Lifecycle Automation for Archival Data
placements.frame: How do institutional policies govern data retention limits, consent boundaries, and automated compliance lifecycles?

placements.title: Bounding Raw Audio Retention by Participant Consent While Preserving Transcripts
placements.frame: How should raw media retention be calibrated to consent horizons to balance preservation value against liability risk?
placements.why: Segments src-1, src-2, and src-3 establish the baseline rule that raw field recordings are kept for eighteen months and then deleted to prevent keeping recordings past consent expiry, while derivative transcripts are retained permanently.

placements.title: Tagging Consent Expiry at Intake to Enable Scheduled Query Deletion
placements.frame: How can intake metadata tagging convert retrospective compliance audits into automated scheduled queries?
placements.why: Segment src-4 specifies an operational directive that cataloguing must tag consent expiry dates during intake to replace periodic manual audits with scheduled deletion queries.
